plotEn:
Aadi is a struggling actor living in Pune with his grandfather, Anant, a retired postmaster who dotes on him. Anant often turns up at Aadi's workplaces carrying his favourite meal of varan bhaat, much to his grandson's embarrassment. The pair meet Gayatri Deshmukh, a social worker with a family connection to Anant, and she and Aadi gradually fall in love.
Anant, a devotee of Dattatreya, takes Aadi and Gayatri on a pilgrimage to Narsobawadi to seek blessings for Aadi's career. There Anant suffers a fall and injures his spine, leaving him bedridden. At the same moment, Aadi receives a call about a significant film role, but he is unable to attend the look test because he has to look after his grandfather. He later secures a lead role from the same producer, but on his very first day of shooting Anant falls again at home, forcing Aadi to abandon the set. Overwhelmed by frustration, Aadi lashes out at his grandfather and nearly strikes him. Over time, Aadi comes to regret his behaviour and seeks Anant's forgiveness.
